source: Owner statement in the College Football Spread Bets ChatGPT project conversation
owner_statement: this whole year i have never picked a single game on my own. everything has been chosen by the model
scope: 2026 season contest selections submitted by owner through the date of this statement
interpretation: All actual owner contest selections this season were chosen by the model according to the owner's direct statement.
Owner approval or submission is not independent human selection. A model-produced contextual review is distinct from a user independently choosing picks.
Attribute recovered actual contest-card outcomes to the model-assisted selection workflow, with owner-attested provenance.
Do not equate an actual submitted card to a specific governed ATS, totals, mixed research, or contextual ranking unless matching selection evidence establishes that identity.

This attestation does not establish which recommendations were submitted in weeks with missing submission evidence, exact model versions, pregame forecast custody, or underlying calibrated confidence.
Contest scoring weights are not automatically model confidence.
reporting_requirements: Preserve separate cohorts for frozen automated engine outputs, model-generated contextual recommendations, and verified submitted cards; match identities and deduplicate overlapping selections.
Use OWNER_ATTESTED_MODEL_ORIGIN for recovered submissions, distinguish from independently verified pregame artifacts.
Do not assign losses or wins to independent owner judgment absent contrary documented evidence.
Where submission evidence is absent, report actual contest record unknown rather than substitute recommendations.
